corpus.id_mapping: paper-{global_chunk_index}; all 940 IDs and exact texts verified against local Chroma SQLite in read-only mode
corpus.page_numbering: 1-based PDF page indices from page_start/page_end, not printed journal page numbers

annotation_policy.relevance: Each listed chunk contributes evidence to at least one expected answer point; several chunks may be needed for the complete answer.
annotation_policy.completeness: Provisional positive labels only; unlabeled chunks are unjudged, not confirmed negatives. Human review must complete the relevant set before formal Recall/MRR.
annotation_policy.freeze: Not frozen. Approve every query, record reviewer/date and issue a new dataset version before use as a held-out benchmark.
annotation_policy.safety: Historical biomedical paper comprehension only, not medical advice. Do not convert experimental hypotheses or toxic compounds into treatment recommendations.
